sections.content: Compare cultural works with *más*/menos... *que* and tan... como. Relative clauses with que and donde identify people, works and places without repeating information. These structures are useful when explaining similarities and differences.

items.spanish: La película es más larga que la novela.
items.english: The film is longer than the novel.

items.spanish: Es una obra que presenta una visión muy diferente.
items.english: It is a work that presents a very different view.

items.spanish: La canción tiene un estilo parecido al que aparece en la película.
items.english: The song has a style similar to the one that appears in the film.

items.spanish: La novela, que fue publicada hace muchos años, sigue siendo popular.
items.english: The novel, which was published many years ago, is still popular.

sections.content: Use a relative clause when you need to identify or add information about a work without starting a completely new sentence.
